subject: Music Production
title: The LinnDrum and Digital Precision
description: One-minute skill: The LinnDrum and Digital Precision.

hook.text: Roger Linn's LM-1, released in 1980, was the first drum machine to use digitally recorded real drum sounds.

buildup.text: Prince purchased one of the first units and used it to produce some of the most iconic 1980s records.

discovery.text: The LinnDrum's crisp, punchy samples defined the sound of pop, new wave, and R&B throughout the decade.

twist.text: Linn later admitted the sounds were recorded quickly and were not his best drumming performances.

climax.text: The LinnDrum proved that sampled drums could replace session musicians on professional recordings.

punchline.text: One man's quick drum recordings defined a whole decade.

quiz.question: What was revolutionary about the LM-1?
options: It was the cheapest drum machine ever made
It was the first to use digitally recorded real drum sounds
It could play back full songs
